title: Mystical Mustache Portrait
description: A stylized portrait of a person with closed eyes wearing a large green hat and an ornate, floral-patterned mustache. A black cat perches on their shoulder while smaller duplicate figures and glowing orbs labeled with words like SPELLS, ORBS, and AMULETS float against a dark background filled with white flowers, green foliage, and celestial symbols.
prompt: A surreal portrait of a serene figure with closed eyes wearing a large green wide-brimmed hat with a blue ribbon, an elaborate white floral mustache, and a flowing mauve robe decorated with black berries. A black cat sits on their shoulder. Smaller duplicate figures appear on both sides. Floating magical orbs labeled SPELLS, ORBS, AMULETS, and celestial symbols including suns and a purple-blue moon are set against a black background filled with white flowers and lush green foliage in a stylized, illustrative manner.
